cohort: The study included 85 pregnant women with hypothyroidism and 87 euthyroid pregnant women.
finding: Fetal behavior differences, as measured by KANET scores, were observed in women with hypothyroidism compared to euthyroid women, with the control group reporting higher scores.
cross-section timing: Antenatal, from 28 weeks to 38 weeks gestation
gest_age: Average gestational age at KANET application was 33 +/- 1.6 weeks for the hypothyroidic group and 33 +/- 2.1 weeks for the euthyroidic group.
